picks.matchup: New York Jets vs New York Giants
picks.analysis: The New York Giants head into the preseason finale with a focused QB competition that has gotten plenty of attention. Head Coach Brian Daboll will likely want to solidify the starting positions ahead of the regular season, giving their first-team some extended snaps. The Jets, meanwhile, might not prioritize performance as they work through their roster evaluations. Historically, the Giants have had strong preseason outings, and with Daboll's tactical inclination, expect them to cover the spread.

picks.matchup: Las Vegas Raiders vs San Francisco 49ers
picks.analysis: The Las Vegas Raiders have been turning heads with their revamped offseason squad and should continue to impress against the San Francisco 49ers. With the Raiders' new acquisitions and system under Head Coach Josh McDaniels, they will want to make a statement at home. San Francisco might be more focused on rounding out depth chart battles, which can affect their ability to counter the Raiders' aggressive plays.

With their cohesive defensive unit and an offense that's showing significant depth, they are poised to overpower the Commanders. Washington, on the other hand, is still working through a few lineup uncertainties, and these dynamics often lead to struggles against experienced opponents like the Ravens.

picks.matchup: Cleveland Browns vs New England Patriots
picks.analysis: Bill Belichick's Patriots aim to solidify their strategy before the regular season, making this a critical rehearsal. With the Browns focusing on evaluating younger talents and resting starters, the Patriots' disciplined gameplay and depth could create a significant advantage. Expect the Patriots to lean on this experience and cover against a still-developing Browns team.

picks.matchup: Los Angeles Rams vs Los Angeles Chargers
picks.analysis: With both Los Angeles teams likely to rest key starters, scoring might come at a premium. The Rams, dealing with depth concerns, might employ a conservative strategy to avoid injuries. The Chargers, similarly, could focus on trying out different defensive rotations, pointing towards a low-scoring contest. Given these preseason tactics, betting the under appears sound.
